retained_stopped_attempt.immutability: Do not delete, overwrite, rename, or modify the original artifact directory, fresh version cache, four completed canary reports, original receipt, stopped result, or stopped-result test.

only_instrument_correction.scope: Replace the pip-audit canary and repository invocation path only. Do not modify pip-audit, ScaAdapter, any other scanner adapter, scanner rules, retrieval, slicing, claims, configuration, pipeline, store, CLI, or production integration.
only_instrument_correction.positive_canary: One isolated requirements.txt containing only requests==2.19.1; require valid JSON, at least one advisory, exact version provenance, and exit status zero or one.
only_instrument_correction.clean_canary: One isolated empty requirements.txt; require valid JSON, zero advisories, exact version provenance, and exit status zero or one.
only_instrument_correction.repository_rule: Audit only root-level requirements*.txt files for which every active requirement is a direct exact name==version pin. A repository without such a file is explicit not-applicable. Any root requirements file containing an unpinned, ranged, editable, URL, path, option, include, constraint, marker-ambiguous, or otherwise non-direct entry is a retained terminal scanner failure, not a relaxed or silently partial audit.
only_instrument_correction.output_contract: Parse in memory through the frozen pip-audit JSON parser; retain only execution provenance and aggregate finding count outside raw isolated scanner artifacts.

Rerun separated offline Semgrep, supplemental Semgrep, and Gitleaks canaries, then the corrected no-resolution pip-audit canary, then the unchanged OSV canary; every canary must pass before acquisition.
Do not contact semgrep.dev, use registry rules, invoke a dependency resolver or installer, retry a failed canary, or reuse a canary result from the stopped directory.

resumed_execution.rule: Only after every corrected canary passes, process the same six subjects in the same order under every original exact-commit, snapshot, detector-input, RetrievalIndex, scanner-health, verifier-eligibility, terminal-state, local-artifact, aggregate-result, outcome-blind, and stop boundary.

Unavailable, failed, partial, malformed, disabled, missing provenance, incomplete inventory, or unsupported direct-pin manifest is a retained terminal failure and stops before the next subject.
resumed_execution.raw_artifact_boundary: Exact public snapshots and raw local scanner artifacts remain only in the corrected artifact directory. The result discloses only aggregate counts, statuses, and digests.

stop_conditions: Any retained failed evidence is modified or any frozen source, commit, selection, store, implementation, tool, rule, branch, index, or initially absent corrected-directory identity drifts.

Any pip-audit process omits --disable-pip or --no-deps, invokes pip or dependency resolution, follows an unsupported manifest, contacts a host other than pypi.org, retries, or returns invalid or absent JSON.
Any corrected canary fails or any repository scanner is unavailable, failed, partial, malformed, disabled, missing provenance, or incomplete except for explicit valid not-applicable status.
